pdf-organizer.empty.title: Open a file or create a PDF

pdf-organizer.error.unknown: Something went wrong while opening this file.
pdf-organizer.hint.zoom: You can also hold Ctrl and turn the mouse wheel.
pdf-organizer.hint.fitPage: Show the whole page in the window.
pdf-organizer.hint.fitWidth: Make the page as wide as the window.
pdf-organizer.hint.fitHeight: Make the page as tall as the window.
pdf-organizer.hint.coverPage: In two-page view, show the first page alone, like a book cover.
pdf-organizer.hint.scrolling: On: all pages one under another. Off: one page at a time; the mouse wheel turns pages.
pdf-organizer.hint.rotate: Turn the entire document a quarter, for viewing only: the file is not changed. To turn pages in the file, use Organize.
pdf-organizer.hint.readMode: Hide the bars and panels. Press Esc to leave.
pdf-organizer.hint.fullScreen: Fill the whole screen with the document. Press Esc to leave.
pdf-organizer.recent.title: Recent files
pdf-organizer.hint.organizePages: Show all pages in a grid to select, turn, move, remove or add pages. Nothing changes on disk until you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.saveAs: Write the document, as arranged now, to a new file. The original stays as it is.
pdf-organizer.hint.extractPages: Take the selected pages out into a new tab, as a document that is not saved yet.
pdf-organizer.hint.insertPages: Add the pages of another file (PDF, picture, text, office document) after the selected page, or at the end.
pdf-organizer.hint.deletePages: Remove the selected pages from this document. The original file is not changed.
pdf-organizer.organize.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No pages selected} one {# page selected} other {# pages selected}}
pdf-organizer.organize.help: Click to select, Ctrl+click to add, Shift+click for a range. Drag selected pages to move them.
pdf-organizer.thumbnailSize.label: Thumbnail size
pdf-organizer.error.saveFailed: The file could not be saved. Check that the folder can be written to and try again.
pdf-organizer.error.destinationInUse: That file is open in the program. Choose another name: saving over an open file is not supported yet.
pdf-organizer.error.insertFailed: The pages could not be added. The file may be damaged, protected, or of a kind the program does not read.
pdf-organizer.hint.save: Write the document, as arranged now, over its own file.
pdf-organizer.error.fileBusy: The file could not be replaced: another program may have it open. Nothing was changed. Close it there and save again, or use "Save as…".
pdf-organizer.hint.replacePages: Put the pages of another file (PDF, picture, text, office document) in place of the selected pages.
pdf-organizer.hint.splitDocument: Write the document as several smaller files. This document stays as it is.
pdf-organizer.split.title: Split document
pdf-organizer.split.lead: The document is written as several new files. This document is not changed.
pdf-organizer.split.every: A new file every this many pages:
pdf-organizer.split.atSelection: A new file starts at each selected page
pdf-organizer.split.result: {count, plural, one {This makes # file.} other {This makes # files.}}
pdf-organizer.split.onePart: This would make a single file. Choose a smaller number or other pages.
pdf-organizer.split.done: {count, plural, one {# file was written to {folder}.} other {# files were written to {folder}.}}
pdf-organizer.error.splitFilesExist: That folder already has files with these names. Nothing was written. Choose another folder.
pdf-organizer.hint.print: Print the document as arranged now.
pdf-organizer.hint.share: Send the file with another app: mail, a nearby device and others.
pdf-organizer.hint.shareUnsaved: Send the file with another app. The file is shared as last saved: save first to include your changes.
pdf-organizer.error.printFailed: The document could not be prepared for printing. Try again.
pdf-organizer.error.shareFailed: The file could not be shared.
pdf-organizer.hint.find: Look for a word or a phrase in the text of the document.
pdf-organizer.binder.summary: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
pdf-organizer.binder.pagesOf: {chosen} of {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
pdf-organizer.binder.emptyTitle: Put several files into one PDF
pdf-organizer.binder.emptyHint: Add PDFs, pictures, text files, e-books and Word, Excel or PowerPoint documents; put them in order and, for each, choose the pages that go in. The files themselves are not changed.
pdf-organizer.hint.newBinder: Gather several PDFs to write them as one file.
pdf-organizer.hint.addFiles: Add PDFs, pictures, text files, e-books and office documents to the binder.
pdf-organizer.hint.combineFiles: Write the files of the binder, in order, as one new PDF.
pdf-organizer.hint.cropPages: Cut the edges off pages. Nothing is removed from the file: the pages only show less.
pdf-organizer.hint.resizePages: Put pages on another sheet size (A4, Letter…). The content is scaled to fit.
pdf-organizer.shape.chosenPages: {count, plural, =0 {No page chosen} one {The chosen page} other {The # chosen pages}}
pdf-organizer.shape.allPages: {count, plural, one {The whole document (# page)} other {The whole document (# pages)}}
pdf-organizer.crop.lead: Drag on the page to draw the frame that is kept, or type the margins. The red parts will no longer show or print; nothing is removed from the file.
pdf-organizer.resize.lead: Each page is put on a sheet of the chosen size: scaled to fit and centered, never cut.
pdf-organizer.resize.matchOrientation: Turn the sheet for wide pages
pdf-organizer.error.reshapeFailed: The pages could not be changed.
pdf-organizer.hint.pageNumbers: Number the pages: where, in which format (also a text of your own), font, size and color. Shown on the pages while you set them up.
pdf-organizer.hint.watermark: Write a word across the pages: DRAFT, COPY, a name.
pdf-organizer.hint.properties: What the document says about itself: title, author, dates, size.
pdf-organizer.hint.bookmarks: Show the document's table of contents beside the pages.
pdf-organizer.side.label: Beside the pages
pdf-organizer.properties.title: Title
pdf-organizer.properties.author: Author
pdf-organizer.properties.subject: Subject
pdf-organizer.properties.creator: Written with
pdf-organizer.hint.addText: Click on the page and type. Choose the font, the size, bold, italic and the alignment; the text can be moved, resized and turned afterwards.
pdf-organizer.hint.addImage: Choose a picture, then drag on the page where it goes and how large. It can be moved, resized and turned afterwards.
pdf-organizer.hint.addShape: Draw rectangles, ellipses, lines, arrows, ticks and crosses on the pages. They can be moved, resized, turned and restyled afterwards, and are written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.signVisual: Draw your signature, type it in a font you choose, or use a picture of it, with the date under it if you want. Then drag on the page where it goes; from the panel it can be put on other pages too.
pdf-organizer.signature.padHint: Sign with the mouse, a pen or a finger
pdf-organizer.signature.keep: Keep this signature for next time
pdf-organizer.signature.note: Signatures are kept on this computer only. This is a picture (or the text) of a signature, not a certificate-based one.
pdf-organizer.error.notAPicture: That file could not be read as a picture.
pdf-organizer.error.pictureTooLarge: That picture is too large. Use one under 40 MB.
pdf-organizer.hint.fillForm: Show the fields of the form, to type your answers in. They are written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.noForm: This document has no form yet. Start one: draw a text field (check boxes and signature fields are beside this button). After saving, the fields can be filled in.
pdf-organizer.hint.compress: Save the document as a smaller file, by making its photographs smaller.
pdf-organizer.compress.lead: The document is saved as a new, smaller file. Photographs and scans get fewer pixels; text and drawings stay exactly as they are. This document is not changed.
pdf-organizer.compress.balancedHint: good on screen, fine on paper
pdf-organizer.compress.done: Saved: {before, number, ::.0#} MB became {after, number, ::.0#} MB ({percent}% smaller).
pdf-organizer.compress.doneNoGain: Saved, but the file did not get smaller ({after, number, ::.0#} MB): it has no photographs to shrink.
pdf-organizer.hint.redact: Mark what must be removed for good: drag a black box over it, on any page. The text and pictures under it are taken out of the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.compare: Choose another PDF and see, page by page, where its text differs from this one.
pdf-organizer.hint.compareUnsaved: Choose another PDF and see where its text differs from this one. This document is compared as last saved.
pdf-organizer.compare.title: Compare
pdf-organizer.compare.failed: The two documents could not be compared. One of them may be damaged or protected.
pdf-organizer.compare.same: The text of the two documents is the same.
pdf-organizer.compare.summary: {count, plural, one {# page of {total} differs} other {# pages of {total} differ}}
pdf-organizer.compare.noPage: No such page in this document
pdf-organizer.compare.moreLines: {count, plural, one {…and # more line} other {…and # more lines}}
pdf-organizer.signature.removePaper: Keep the pen strokes only, without the paper behind them
pdf-organizer.error.needsOffice: Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are converted by Microsoft Office or LibreOffice, and neither was found on this computer.
pdf-organizer.error.officeTimedOut: The office program took too long to convert the file and was stopped. Open the file in it once, answer what it asks, then try again.
pdf-organizer.viewer.zoomValueHint: Click to type a zoom or pick one from the list.
pdf-organizer.hint.rotateAll: Turn every page of the document a quarter. Written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.open: Open a file in a tab. A PDF opens as it is; a picture, a text file or another document becomes a new PDF, not saved yet.
pdf-organizer.hint.openSeveral: Choose several files; each opens in a tab of its own. A PDF opens as it is; any other file becomes a new PDF, not saved yet.
pdf-organizer.hint.createPdf: Make a PDF from a file, from several files (combined, or one PDF each), from a saved web page, from the clipboard, or start with empty pages.
pdf-organizer.empty.dropTip: You can also drop files here or paste them (Ctrl+V): they are gathered in a binder.
pdf-organizer.defaultApp.thanks: You’re awesome! Thank you for using this open source software as your default PDF app.
pdf-organizer.defaultApp.offer: Make PDF Organizer your default PDF app
pdf-organizer.defaultApp.failed: The settings of default apps could not be opened. Open Settings › Apps › Default apps and choose Syntelab Creative.
pdf-organizer.drop.toBinder: Drop the files to gather them in a binder
pdf-organizer.drop.intoBinder: Drop the files to add them to this binder
pdf-organizer.error.someFilesSkipped: Some files were left out: they are not documents, pictures or text the program can read, or they are too large.
pdf-organizer.error.extractFailed: The pages could not be taken out.
pdf-organizer.extract.lead: {count, plural, one {The page opens in a new tab, as a document that is not saved yet.} other {The # pages open in a new tab, as a document that is not saved yet.}}
pdf-organizer.extract.remove: Delete the pages from this document after extracting
pdf-organizer.extract.separate: Extract each page as a separate document
pdf-organizer.extract.separateTooMany: (for up to {count} pages; use Split document for more)
pdf-organizer.hint.settings: How documents open, what the quick toolbar shows, how new documents are named. For this app only.
pdf-organizer.settings.openingNote: What you change while reading stays with that tab; this is how the next document starts.
pdf-organizer.settings.openScrollingHint: On: all pages in one long strip. Off: one page at a time; the mouse wheel goes to the next.
pdf-organizer.settings.openThumbnails: Show the small pages on the side
pdf-organizer.settings.quickToolbarNote: The strip above the pages. Choose what it shows; every command stays in the menus as well.
pdf-organizer.settings.namesNote: In a name, {name} stands for the name of the document the pages come from, and {number} for a number that counts up.
pdf-organizer.settings.extractNameHint: The pages taken out of a document, as one new document.
pdf-organizer.settings.extractEachNameHi: Each page as a document of its own; {number} is its place in the order extracted.
pdf-organizer.settings.newNameHint: A PDF made from other files or by combining; {number} counts the documents made.
pdf-organizer.settings.resetAllNote: Puts every setting on this page back as the program shipped it. The layout above and the general settings are not touched.
pdf-organizer.hint.highlight: Drag over what you want to stand out. What is under the highlight stays readable.
pdf-organizer.marks.redactNote: Drag over what must go. It is removed from the file for good when you save; until then the box can be moved or deleted.
pdf-organizer.watermark.movable: Afterwards the watermark can be moved, resized and turned on each page, like anything drawn on it.
pdf-organizer.crop.together: Same margin on all four sides
pdf-organizer.crop.pagesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No page would be cropped.} one {# page will be cropped.} other {# pages will be cropped.}}
pdf-organizer.create.title: Create a PDF
pdf-organizer.create.about.file: A picture, a text file, an e-book or a Word, Excel or PowerPoint document becomes a PDF with the same name. The file itself is not changed.
pdf-organizer.create.about.combine: Choose the files. They are laid out in a binder, where you put them in order and choose the pages of each; "Combine" then makes one PDF of them.
pdf-organizer.create.about.each: Choose the files. Each becomes a PDF of its own, in a tab of its own.
pdf-organizer.create.about.web-page: A web page you saved from your browser as a file (.html). The program does not go online to fetch pages: your documents never leave this computer.
pdf-organizer.create.about.clipboard: What you copied: a picture, a part of the screen, text, or files copied in the file manager. Press Ctrl+V in this window, or use the button.
pdf-organizer.create.about.blank: A new document of empty pages, to draw and write on or to add pages to.
pdf-organizer.create.paste: Use what is on the clipboard
pdf-organizer.create.clipboardEmpty: There is nothing on the clipboard that can become a PDF.
pdf-organizer.create.clipboardNothingUsa: What is on the clipboard cannot become pages.
pdf-organizer.create.clipboardUseKeys: The system did not let the program read the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V in this window instead.
pdf-organizer.create.unsaved: What is made opens in a tab, not saved yet: Save asks where to put it.
pdf-organizer.hint.rulers: Show rulers along the top and the left of the pages, counting from the corner of the page in view. The unit is a setting of PDF Organizer.
pdf-organizer.hint.grid: Show a grid of lines over the pages, to line things up by. It is not printed and not saved.
pdf-organizer.settings.measuringNote: Rulers and grid are switched on and off in the View menu; this is how a document starts.
pdf-organizer.settings.printingNote: What the print window starts with. The printer and the number of copies are chosen there.
pdf-organizer.settings.shortcutsNote: The keys PDF Organizer answers to. Click the keys of a command and press the new ones; each can be put back on its own.
pdf-organizer.keys.ctrlWheelDoes: Zoom in and out, around the pointer; in Organize and in a binder, make the thumbnails larger or smaller
pdf-organizer.keys.pasteDoes: Paste copied files or pictures into a binder
pdf-organizer.keys.deleteDoes: Remove the selected pages, or the selected drawing
pdf-organizer.keys.escapeDoes: Leave the drawing tools, read mode or full screen
pdf-organizer.hint.exportAs: Write the document in another format: a Word or OpenDocument file, plain text, a web page, pictures of the pages (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, SVG) or PostScript.
pdf-organizer.export.title: Export
pdf-organizer.export.lead: The document as it is now, with everything drawn and written on it, is written in another format. The PDF itself stays as it is.
pdf-organizer.export.onePerPage: {count, plural, other {One file for each of the # pages, with the page number at the end of its name.}}
pdf-organizer.export.done: {count, plural, one {The file was written in {folder}.} other {# files were written in {folder}.}}
pdf-organizer.error.exportFailed: The document could not be exported.
pdf-organizer.error.exportFilesExist: Files with those names are already in that folder. Choose another name or another folder.
pdf-organizer.create.about.web-address: Type or paste the address of a page. It is fetched and laid out by the browser installed on this computer, without its window, cookies or history, and saved as a PDF. This is the only time the program goes to an address other than syntelab.com, and only when you ask.
pdf-organizer.create.notAnAddress: That is not the address of a web page.
pdf-organizer.create.noBrowser: No browser that can save a page as a PDF was found on this computer (Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome).
pdf-organizer.create.pageFailed: The page could not be reached or saved. Check the address and the connection.
pdf-organizer.export.about.docx: A document for Microsoft Word and the like. The text is rebuilt where it stands on the pages; it can be edited, but a complicated layout will not come out the same.
pdf-organizer.export.about.odt: A document for LibreOffice and the like, rebuilt the same way as a Word document.
pdf-organizer.export.about.txt: The words only, page after page, without fonts or pictures.
pdf-organizer.export.about.html: The text with its fonts and places, to open in a browser.
pdf-organizer.export.about.xml: The text with the place of every letter, for other programs to read.
pdf-organizer.export.about.png: A picture of each page, exact, with no loss. Best for pages with text and drawings.
pdf-organizer.export.about.jpg: A picture of each page, smaller than PNG. Best for pages that are photographs.
pdf-organizer.export.about.tiff: One file with a picture of every page, as scanners and archives use.
pdf-organizer.export.about.svg: A drawing of each page that stays sharp at any size.
pdf-organizer.export.about.ps: For printers and print shops that ask for it.
pdf-organizer.hint.copyPages: Remember the selected pages, to paste copies of them elsewhere in this document (Ctrl+C in the grid of pages).
pdf-organizer.hint.cutPages: Take the selected pages out, to paste them elsewhere in this document (Ctrl+X in the grid of pages).
pdf-organizer.hint.pastePages: Put the copied pages after the selected ones (Ctrl+V in the grid of pages).
pdf-organizer.crop.onPage: Drag on the page to draw the frame that is kept; zoom and scroll as you like. The red parts will no longer show or print; nothing is removed from the file.
pdf-organizer.range.title: Pages
pdf-organizer.range.count: {count, plural, =0 {No page.} one {# page.} other {# pages.}}
pdf-organizer.range.unreadable: Write page numbers and stretches, like 1, 3, 5-8.
pdf-organizer.numbers.skipFirst: No number on the first page
pdf-organizer.numbers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No page gets a number.} one {# page gets a number.} other {# pages get a number.}}
pdf-organizer.numbers.movable: On the pages the numbers are text like any other: each can still be moved or deleted with the drawing tools.
pdf-organizer.export.resolutionAbout: Dots per inch say how fine the picture is: how many dots of it cover one inch (2.54 cm) of the page. More dots: sharper, and a larger file.
pdf-organizer.export.resolutionAbout.72: 72 is enough to look at on a screen.
pdf-organizer.export.resolutionAbout.150: 150 reads well on screen and prints acceptably: a good middle.
pdf-organizer.export.resolutionAbout.600: 600 is for fine print and for enlarging; the files are large.
pdf-organizer.export.qualityAbout: Quality trades size for detail: 100 keeps everything, around 85 is hard to tell from it and much smaller, under 60 shows blotches around letters.
pdf-organizer.settings.openZoom.about.fi: The whole page is in view.
The page is as wide as the window; you scroll down through it.
The page is as tall as the window.
pdf-organizer.settings.openZoom.about.ac: The page at 100%, the size it has on paper.
pdf-organizer.settings.unit.about.mm: For the rulers, the grid and the sizes of pages and margins. A millimetre is a tenth of a centimetre; an A4 sheet is 210 × 297 mm.
pdf-organizer.settings.unit.about.in: For the rulers, the grid and the sizes of pages and margins. An inch is 25.4 mm; a Letter sheet is 8.5 × 11 inches.
pdf-organizer.settings.unit.about.pt: For the rulers, the grid and the sizes of pages and margins. A point is 1/72 of an inch (0.35 mm): the unit letters are measured in, and PDF files themselves.
pdf-organizer.settings.printSheetHint: The paper the print window starts with; it can still be changed there.
The sheet is turned sideways for pages wider than they are tall, page by page.
Every sheet upright; a wide page is made smaller to fit.
Every sheet sideways; a tall page is made smaller to fit.
pdf-organizer.settings.printScaling.abou: Each page is made as large as its sheet allows.
Each page is printed at the size it has, in the middle of the sheet; a page larger than the sheet is still made to fit.
pdf-organizer.hint.close: Close this document. You are asked first when it has changes that are not saved.
pdf-organizer.hint.undo: Take back the last change made to the document.
pdf-organizer.hint.redo: Do again what was just taken back.
pdf-organizer.hint.rotateLeft: Turn the selected pages (or the page in view) a quarter to the left. Written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.rotateRight: Turn the selected pages (or the page in view) a quarter to the right. Written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.rotateAllLeft: Turn every page of the document a quarter to the left. Written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.rotateAllRight: Turn every page of the document a quarter to the right. Written into the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.selectAll: Select every page, in the grid of pages.
pdf-organizer.hint.moveEarlier: Move the selected pages one place toward the start of the document.
pdf-organizer.hint.moveLater: Move the selected pages one place toward the end of the document.
pdf-organizer.hint.signCertificate: Sign the document with a certificate: one of this computer, one on a card or a token, or one in a file. The signed document is saved as a new file; whoever opens it can check who signed and that nothing was changed.
pdf-organizer.hint.signBatch: Sign many PDF files at once with a certificate, with the signature in the same place on each of them.
pdf-organizer.hint.timestamp: Add a time stamp to the whole document: a time-stamping authority confirms that the document was, exactly as it is, at this moment. No certificate is needed. The document is saved as a new file.
pdf-organizer.hint.verifySignatures: See who signed the document with a certificate, when, and whether it was changed afterwards.
pdf-organizer.hint.ocr: Read the text of scanned pages, so the document can be searched and its text copied. The pages look the same afterwards.
pdf-organizer.hint.batch: Do the same things to many files at once: turn them into PDFs, turn or number their pages, make them smaller, sign them, write them out in another format. Each result is a new file, or everything goes into one PDF. What you choose can be kept as a recipe.
pdf-organizer.settings.shortcutHow: Esc leaves the keys as they are; Delete takes them away. Keys given to one command are taken from the one that had them.
pdf-organizer.numbers.customHint: Write {number} where the page number goes and {count} where the number of pages goes.
pdf-organizer.numbers.live: The numbers show on the pages as you set them up; zoom and go through the pages to see how they come out.
pdf-organizer.marks.tool.edit: Edit the text and pictures of the document
pdf-organizer.marks.editNote: Click a line of the document to change its words, or a picture of the document to move, resize, turn or delete it. What stood there is taken out of the file when you save.
pdf-organizer.marks.eraseNote: The text that stood here is taken out of the file when you save. Delete this to keep the old text.
pdf-organizer.marks.repeatHint: Put the selected object on other pages as well. Moved or changed on one page, it follows on all of them.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.select: Click an object to select it. Drag it to move it, its handles to resize it, the round handle above it to turn it. Delete removes it; the arrow keys move it by small steps; Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V and Ctrl+D copy it.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.draw: Drag on the page to draw it; a click puts it there at a usual size. What is selected can still be moved and resized.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.text: Click where the text starts and type; click beside it when you are done. Double-click a text to change its words.
pdf-organizer.marks.textNote: Drag a corner of the text to make its letters larger or smaller.
pdf-organizer.marks.placing: Drag on the page where it should go, as large as you want it. A click puts it there at a usual size.
pdf-organizer.signature.typeSample: Your name shows here the way it will look
pdf-organizer.signature.pictureSample: Choose a picture of your signature
pdf-organizer.signature.dateNote: Today is filled in by itself. Choose another day to date the signature earlier or later.
pdf-organizer.hint.insertBlankPage: Add an empty page after the page in view (or after the selected pages), the same size as that one.
pdf-organizer.hint.headerFooter: Write a text at the top and at the bottom of the pages: the name of the document, the date, the page number. It shows on the pages as you set it up.
pdf-organizer.hint.batesNumbers: Number the pages one after another with a word before or after (ABC000123), as it is done for the documents of a case.
pdf-organizer.hint.addLink: Drag over the place that should be clicked, then say where it leads: a web address, or a page of this document.
pdf-organizer.hint.addBookmark: Click the place a new bookmark should lead to and give it a title. It joins the bookmarks of the document when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.attachFile: Choose a file and click where its paper clip goes. The file is kept inside the PDF when you save.
pdf-organizer.hint.addTextField: Drag where a field to type into should be. After saving, it can be filled in here and in any PDF reader.
pdf-organizer.hint.addCheckBox: Click where a box to tick should be. After saving, it can be ticked here and in any PDF reader.
pdf-organizer.hint.addSignatureField: Drag where the document should be signed with a certificate. The field is left empty for the signer.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.link: Drag over what should be clicked (a word, a picture), then say below where it leads. Nothing is drawn there: the frame shows only while you work.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.bookmark: Click the place the bookmark should lead to, then give it a title below.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.field: Drag where the field should be, then name it below. It becomes a field of the form when you save.
pdf-organizer.marks.link.note: An address without its beginning gets https:// in front; an e-mail address opens a new message. A link to a page follows that page when pages are moved.
pdf-organizer.marks.field.name: Name of the field
pdf-organizer.marks.field.note: The name tells the fields apart for whoever reads the answers; each field needs its own.
pdf-organizer.marks.field.signNote: A place for a signature with a certificate. It stays empty until someone signs.
pdf-organizer.marks.bookmark.title: Title of the bookmark
pdf-organizer.marks.bookmark.note: It leads to this place on the page and is listed after the bookmarks the document already has.
pdf-organizer.marks.attachment.note: The file is put inside the PDF when you save; the paper clip shows where, and can be resized by its corners and turned. Delete the paper clip to leave the file out. Insert → Attached files lists them all.
pdf-organizer.headerFooter.lead: Type what stands at the top and at the bottom of the pages. It shows on the pages as you type.
pdf-organizer.headerFooter.words: Write {page} for the number of the page, {pages} for the number of pages, {date} for the date of today and {file} for the name of the document.
pdf-organizer.bates.lead: Each page gets the next number, with the same number of digits. It shows on the pages as you set it up.
pdf-organizer.marks.duplicateHint: A copy beside it (Ctrl+D). Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy it to another page.
pdf-organizer.marks.attachment.name: Name of the file
pdf-organizer.marks.attachment.author: Author
pdf-organizer.hint.attachedFiles: See the files kept inside this document, save one of them to the computer, or attach another.
pdf-organizer.attachments.title: Attached files
pdf-organizer.attachments.none: This document has no attached files.
pdf-organizer.attachments.pendingNote: These are put inside the PDF the next time you save. Until then they stay where they are on this computer.
pdf-organizer.attachments.failed: The file could not be saved.
pdf-organizer.hint.addRadioButton: Click where a round button should be. Buttons of one group go together: choosing one clears the others.
pdf-organizer.hint.addChoiceField: Drag where a list that drops down should be, then type its answers in the panel.
pdf-organizer.marks.hint.radio: Click once for each answer. The buttons you draw one after another are one group: only one of them can be chosen.
pdf-organizer.marks.field.value: The answer this button stands for
pdf-organizer.marks.field.radioNote: Buttons with the same group name belong together: choosing one clears the others.
pdf-organizer.resize.keepSize: Do not make the page larger (only smaller, when it would not fit)
pdf-organizer.resize.place: Where the page lies on the sheet
pdf-organizer.resize.placeNote: In the room that is left around it.
pdf-organizer.error.linkNotOpened: The link could not be opened.
pdf-organizer.sign.none: This computer has no certificate that can sign. One on a card or a token shows here once the card is in its reader; a certificate in a file can be used below.
pdf-organizer.sign.invisibleNote: Nothing shows on the pages; the signature is in the file and is found by "Verify signatures" and by any PDF reader.
pdf-organizer.sign.wrongPassword: The password does not open the certificate file.
pdf-organizer.sign.noCertificateInFile: No certificate that can sign was found in the file.
pdf-organizer.sign.noCertificate: The certificate was not found. If it is on a card or a token, check that it is in its reader.
pdf-organizer.sign.unsupported: Signing with a certificate works on Windows only, for now.
pdf-organizer.sign.failed: The document could not be signed.
pdf-organizer.sign.areaHint: First drag on the page the area where the signature will show. Then you choose the certificate and how the signature looks.
pdf-organizer.sign.areaHintStop: Do not show this again (it can be turned back on in Settings)
pdf-organizer.sign.invisible: Sign without showing it on a page
pdf-organizer.sign.dragArea: Drag on the page the area where the signature will show. A click puts a box of a usual size there.
pdf-organizer.sign.stepCertificate: Choose the certificate you sign with. A signature with a certificate says who signed and seals the document: any later change shows.
pdf-organizer.sign.reasonAndPlaceNote: They are written into the signature: PDF readers show them in its details, and on the page when the appearance shows them. For example: "I approve this document", "Bucharest". The signature is just as valid without them.
pdf-organizer.verify.none: This document has no signature made with a certificate.
pdf-organizer.verify.signedOn: On {moment} (by the clock of the signer’s computer)
pdf-organizer.verify.unchanged: The document has not been changed since it was signed.
pdf-organizer.verify.addedTo: What was signed is unchanged, but something was added to the file afterwards.
pdf-organizer.verify.changed: The document was changed after it was signed, or the signature is damaged.
pdf-organizer.verify.trust.trusted: The certificate comes from an authority this computer trusts.
pdf-organizer.verify.trust.expired: The certificate comes from a trusted authority, but it is not valid today.
pdf-organizer.verify.trust.untrusted: This computer does not know the authority behind the certificate (or the signer made it themselves).
pdf-organizer.verify.trust.unknown: The certificate could not be checked.
pdf-organizer.verify.offline: Checked on this computer, without going online. Validate asks the issuer whether a certificate has been revoked.
pdf-organizer.verify.ofTheFile: The check is of the file as it was last saved; your changes since are not in it.
pdf-organizer.batch.none: No files yet. Add the ones to work on.
pdf-organizer.batch.previewNoFiles: Add files to see here how the signature comes out on each of them.
pdf-organizer.batch.action: What to do with each file
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.compress: Photographs and scans get fewer pixels; text stays sharp.
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.export: Word, text or pictures in place of a PDF. Not together with making smaller or signing.
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.rotate: Every page of every file, the same way.
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.numbers: Each page gets its number, as text.
pdf-organizer.batch.start: {count, plural, =0 {Start} one {Start with # file} other {Start with # files}}
pdf-organizer.batch.exists: A file of this name is already in the folder; it was left as it is.
pdf-organizer.batch.sameFile: The result would take the place of the file itself. Choose another folder, or add something to the name.
pdf-organizer.batch.failed: This file could not be worked on.
pdf-organizer.batch.doneAll: {done, plural, one {# file is done.} other {# files are done.}}
pdf-organizer.batch.doneSome: {done, plural, one {# file is done} other {# files are done}}, {failed, plural, one {# was not} other {# were not}}.
pdf-organizer.marks.erasePictureNote: The picture that was here is taken out of the file when you save. Delete this to keep the picture where it was.
pdf-organizer.error.pictureNotPickedUp: This picture cannot be picked up (its colors are kept in a way only printers use). It stays where it is.
pdf-organizer.ocr.lead: The words of scanned pages are read and written into the pages unseen: the document can then be searched and its text copied. What the pages look like does not change.
pdf-organizer.ocr.noEngine: The engine that reads pages (Tesseract, free and open) is not on this computer. On Windows it is installed with this command, typed into a terminal:
pdf-organizer.ocr.noEngineNote: Windows asks for permission while it installs. Open this window again afterwards.
pdf-organizer.ocr.languagesNote: Tick only the languages the pages are written in: fewer languages read better and faster. More languages can be added from the installer of the engine.
pdf-organizer.ocr.noLanguages: The engine has no language to read in. Install at least one language with it.
pdf-organizer.ocr.skipText: Leave out pages that already have text of their own
pdf-organizer.ocr.failed: A page could not be read. What was read before it is kept.
pdf-organizer.ocr.done: {read, plural, one {The text of # page was read} other {The text of # pages was read}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {; # page was left out} other {; # pages were left out}}. Save the document to keep it and to search in it.
pdf-organizer.ocr.nothing: No text was read: {skipped, plural, =0 {the engine found none on these pages} one {the page already has text of its own} other {the pages already have text of their own}}.
pdf-organizer.sign.preset.extra: Lines of your own, under the name (optional)
pdf-organizer.sign.preset.extraHint: For example: Administrator, Example Company SRL
pdf-organizer.sign.preset.name: Name of this appearance
pdf-organizer.sign.lockNote: After this signature nothing in the document may be changed and no one else can sign it. This cannot be undone.
pdf-organizer.sign.noLockNote: Others can still sign after you; each signature stays good.
pdf-organizer.sign.timeStampNote: {server} confirms the moment of signing, so the signature stays provable after your certificate expires. The issuer of your certificate is also asked whether it is still valid, and its answer is kept in the signature, so Adobe Reader can show the signature as valid. Only fingerprints and the certificate’s serial number are sent, never the document. Needs an internet connection.
pdf-organizer.sign.noTimeStampNote: The signature carries only the time of this computer's clock.
pdf-organizer.timestamp.about: A time-stamping authority confirms that the document was, exactly as it is now, at this moment. Any later change shows. No certificate of yours is needed. The document is saved as a new file.
pdf-organizer.timestamp.online: Only a fingerprint of the document is sent to {server}, never the document itself. Needs an internet connection. The authority can be changed in Settings.
pdf-organizer.timestamp.changed: You have changed the document since it was last saved: the new file has your changes, and signatures the file had are not kept.
pdf-organizer.timestamp.failed: The time-stamping authority could not be reached or did not give a valid time stamp. Check the internet connection, or the address of the authority in Settings.
pdf-organizer.timestamp.wrongAddress: The address of the time-stamping authority is not valid. Check it in Settings.
pdf-organizer.sign.locked: This document was locked by a signature: no other signature can be added to it.
pdf-organizer.sign.signedBefore: This document is already signed (signatures: {count}). Yours is added after them and they stay good.
pdf-organizer.sign.signedAndChanged: This document is already signed (signatures: {count}) and you have changed it since: signing it now writes the document anew, without those signatures. To keep them, close without saving, open the file again and sign it without changing anything.
pdf-organizer.verify.signedAfter: What was signed is unchanged; another signature was added after this one.
pdf-organizer.verify.locks: This signature locks the document: nothing may be changed after it and no one else can sign.
pdf-organizer.verify.timeStampBy: Time stamp of the document, by {authority}
pdf-organizer.verify.stampUnchanged: The document has not been changed since the time stamp.
pdf-organizer.verify.stampChanged: The document was changed after the time stamp, or the time stamp is damaged.
pdf-organizer.verify.stampTrust.trusted: The time stamp comes from an authority this computer trusts.
pdf-organizer.verify.stampTrust.expired: The time stamp comes from a trusted authority whose certificate is not valid today.
pdf-organizer.verify.stampTrust.untruste: This computer does not know the authority that gave the time stamp.
pdf-organizer.verify.stampTrust.unknown: The authority of the time stamp could not be checked.
pdf-organizer.verify.confirmedOn: Time confirmed by a time stamp: {moment}
pdf-organizer.verify.stampBroken: The signature has a time stamp, but it does not match the signature or cannot be checked.
pdf-organizer.verify.revocation.good: Checked online just now: the certificate has not been revoked.
pdf-organizer.verify.revocation.revoked: Checked online just now: the certificate has been revoked.
pdf-organizer.verify.revocation.unknown: The issuer could not be asked or did not answer. Check the internet connection and try again.
pdf-organizer.verify.certificateNotShown: The certificate could not be shown.
pdf-organizer.verify.trustHint: If you know where it comes from, open the certificate and choose Install Certificate to trust it.
pdf-organizer.batch.dropHere: Drop the files to add them to the list
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.sign: One certificate and one appearance for all. Always done last.
pdf-organizer.batch.outputNote.each: Ten files give ten results, each named after its file.
pdf-organizer.batch.outputNote.one: The pages of all the files, one after another, in the order of the list.
pdf-organizer.batch.output.onePdfOnly: Only when the result is a PDF.
pdf-organizer.batch.openFolder: Open the folder when it is done
pdf-organizer.batch.folderNotOpened: The folder could not be opened.
pdf-organizer.batch.signPageNote.first: The signature shows on the first page of each file.
pdf-organizer.batch.signPageNote.last: The signature shows on the last page of each file.
pdf-organizer.batch.signPageNote.all: The signature shows on every page of each file. It is still one signature: each page shows it, and a reader verifies it once.
pdf-organizer.batch.signPageNote.none: Nothing shows on the pages; the signature is in the file and is found by "Verify signatures" and by any PDF reader.
pdf-organizer.batch.signSpot: Where the signature goes on the page
pdf-organizer.batch.signSpotNote: Drag the box where the signature goes, draw a new one, or make it larger from its corner. The same place is used on every page; on pages of another size it keeps its size and its place in proportion.
pdf-organizer.batch.needFiles: Add the files to work on.
pdf-organizer.batch.needFolder: Choose the folder the results go to.
pdf-organizer.batch.needCertificate: Choose the certificate to sign with.
pdf-organizer.settings.warnSignedSave: Ask before saving over a signed file
pdf-organizer.settings.warnSignedSaveHin: A file signed with a certificate loses its signatures when it is changed and saved. With this on, "Save" asks first and offers to save as a new file.
pdf-organizer.settings.signAreaHint: Explain the steps before signing with a certificate
pdf-organizer.settings.signAreaHintHint: Before you drag the area of the signature, a window says that the certificate and the appearance are chosen after it.
pdf-organizer.settings.timeStampSignatur: Add a time stamp to signatures
A time-stamping authority confirms when each signature was made, so it stays provable after the certificate expires. It can still be turned off for one signature in the signing window.
pdf-organizer.settings.timeStampServerHi: The address asked for time stamps (RFC 3161). It receives only a fingerprint, never the document. DigiCert's is free and trusted by Adobe Reader and Windows.
pdf-organizer.settings.timeStampServerWr: Not an address: it starts with http:// or https://. The last valid one is kept.
pdf-organizer.signedSave.title: This file is signed
pdf-organizer.signedSave.lead: The file has signatures made with a certificate (signatures: {count}). They cannot stay in a file that has changed: if you save over it, they are removed. Saving as a new file keeps the signed file as it is.
pdf-organizer.signedSave.stopAsking: Do not ask me again (it can be turned back on in Settings)
pdf-organizer.batch.always: Every file becomes a PDF (a PDF stays as it is). Tick what else to do; the numbers show the order.
pdf-organizer.batch.safeTip: Drop files here from a folder to add them. Each result is a new file. If one would take the place of a file already in the folder (your own file, when nothing is added to its name), you are asked first whether to replace it.
pdf-organizer.batch.resizeColumns: Drag to change the width of the columns; double-click to put them back
pdf-organizer.batch.resizeFiles: Drag to make the list of files taller or shorter; double-click to put it back
pdf-organizer.batch.recipe.name: Name of the recipe
pdf-organizer.batch.recipe.nameHint: For example: Sign for the company
pdf-organizer.batch.tooManyFiles: The folder has more than 2000 files that can be worked on; the first 2000 were added.
pdf-organizer.batch.emptyFolder: No file that can be worked on was found in the folder.
pdf-organizer.batch.folderNotRead: The folder could not be read.
pdf-organizer.batch.keepFolders: Keep the folders of the files in the results
pdf-organizer.batch.writeReport: Write a report of the run (a text file beside the results)
pdf-organizer.batch.reportNotWritten: The report could not be written.
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.ocr: Scanned pages become searchable. Pages that already have text are left as they are.
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.header: A line at the top and one at the bottom of every page.
pdf-organizer.batch.kindNote.watermark: Words written faintly across every page.
pdf-organizer.batch.headerNote: In the text, {page} is the page number, {pages} the number of pages, {date} today’s date and {file} the name of the file.
pdf-organizer.batch.noOcrEngine: The engine that reads pages (Tesseract) is not on this computer. More tools → Recognize text (OCR) says how to install it.
pdf-organizer.batch.ocrNote: Tick only the languages the pages are written in. Reading takes a few seconds for each page.
pdf-organizer.batch.needLanguages: Choose at least one language for the text recognition.
pdf-organizer.settings.combinedName: Many files gathered in one PDF (batch processing)
pdf-organizer.settings.combinedNameHint: The name of the file when "Everything in one PDF" is chosen and no other name is typed.
pdf-organizer.batch.timeStamp: Each signature gets a time stamp from {server} (it can be changed in Settings).
pdf-organizer.batch.noTimeStamp: Signatures get no time stamp (it can be turned on in Settings).
pdf-organizer.batch.replace.title: {count, plural, one {Replace a file?} other {Replace # files?}}
pdf-organizer.batch.replace.lead: {count, plural, one {A file of the same name is already where the result goes:} other {Files of the same names are already where # results go:}}
pdf-organizer.batch.replace.safe: Each one is replaced only once its result is complete, so no file is left half written. A file that is open, in a tab here or in another program, is left as it is.
pdf-organizer.batch.notReplaced: The file could not be replaced: it is open, in a tab here or in another program. It was left as it was.
